attested.notes: Correction pass with light voice work. Five factual errors fixed: Business Asset Disposal Relief given as 10% when it has been 18% since 6 April 2026; the CVL fee 'from around £5,000' against the current £3,500 plus VAT, in both the body and the comparison table; the strike-off fee given as £10 in one paragraph and £13 in another; CVL timing 12 to 18 months where the cluster now separates appointment, active work and dissolution; and the comparison table calling director investigation 'discretionary in voluntary' when a conduct report is filed on every director of every insolvent liquidation. Voice: removed an invented anecdote about directors spending £30,000 defending a restoration application that a £5,000 CVL would have resolved, which was fabricated casework built on the wrong fee. Removed a duplicated 'we see this' construction in the opening and a meta-reference paragraph describing what the page does. Added Related Guides. Remaining practitioner observations describe a general pattern rather than specific cases.
